solution_principle: Grasshopper offers three primary curve types from point sets. Polyline: linear segments, fast, exact through points. Interpolate: smooth NURBS curve that passes THROUGH all points. Nurbs Curve: smooth curve where points are the CONTROL POLYGON â€” curve is attracted to but doesn't touch interior points. Degree parameter (Panel=3) affects smoothness. Understanding the difference is essential for surface creation downstream.
